recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for this issue; any future veterinary mapping changes should be evaluated in the Extension Pack patient-animal extension rather than by reintroducing Patient.animal in core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Patient Administration issue requesting Patient.animal.species and Patient.animal.breed to map to v2 PID-35, correcting the old Patient.animal.breed PID-37 mapping and aligning with the renamed PID-35 Taxonomic Classification Code.
initial_application: Git commit 276058c0c9a1ea9d2144a0c2f95d5ba8c2f1d1e2, subject 'Tracker #13194, 12594, 12299', changed the Patient spreadsheet source so Patient.animal.breed moved from 'PID-37' to 'PID-35 (where more detailed value is present)'; Patient.animal.species already mapped to PID-35.
additional_context: Patient is active in the current core build, but source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml no longer contains Patient.animal or PID-35/PID-37 mappings. Current core veterinary narrative points to the patient-animal extension. The old core extension was removed from core in 2023 and now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack, where species maps to PID-35 and breed maps to PID-35 (where more detailed value is present). A stale Patient.animal reference remains in source/profiles/cda.profile.xml, but the cda profile is commented out in source/fhir.ini and is not active build-scope source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk is necessary because the current core source has no remaining incorrect Patient.animal.breed v2 mapping and the replacement Extension Pack artifact already preserves the corrected PID-35 mapping.
